summary: Concurrent cache misses generated a surge of database queries, causing a connection pool spike, DB lock timeout, and a sharp drop in cache hit ratio. Warnings about simultaneous cache miss and pool pressure precede errors indicating service strain.

evidence.excerpt: 2026-08-28T14:04:16Z WARN [catalog-service] [worker-4] Simultaneous cache miss on key 'category:electronics:page1': 32 concurrent requests querying Postgres DB
evidence.interpretation: Shows 32 concurrent requests missed the same cache key, indicating a potential cache stampede.

evidence.excerpt: 2026-08-28T14:04:20Z ERROR [catalog-service] [db] Postgres connection pool spike: 50 concurrent heavy catalog queries
evidence.interpretation: Reports Postgres connection pool spike with 50 concurrent heavy catalog queries, reflecting increased DB load.

evidence.excerpt: 2026-08-28T14:05:00Z ERROR [catalog-service] HTTP GET /api/v1/categories/electronics 503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE - DB lock timeout
evidence.interpretation: HTTP request returned 503 Service Unavailable due to DB lock timeout, showing service impact.

evidence.excerpt: 2026-08-28T14:06:00Z ERROR [catalog-service] Cache hit ratio plummeted to 12.1% under 200 RPS
evidence.interpretation: Cache hit ratio dropped to 12.1% under 200 RPS, indicating cache effectiveness degradation.

evidence.excerpt: 2026-08-28T14:04:08Z WARN [catalog-service] [image-loader] Deprecated image URL format detected in catalog banner payload - distractor
evidence.interpretation: Deprecated image URL format warning, unrelated to cache behavior but noted.
